feature: Cooldowns module card alignment and fixed 16.0-second HUD sample
changes: Center the scaled 16x16 item at the ring center using a local (-8,-8) origin; remove absolute-position integer truncation and ad hoc offsets.
Align the 34-pixel circular sample exactly with the card preview center.
Share item, ring, font, text centering and shadow rendering between the card icon and live/example HUD.
Disable depth testing and depth writes for the ring and timer overlays so item depth cannot hide the text.
Restore caller depth state, depth mask, item Z level and item matrix even when item rendering fails.
Use a cached 16000-ms EnderPearl sample with a fixed 16.0 label; honor the module theme and Colored color in the icon.

recovery_audit.meaning: Recovery audit only; does not assert successful source compilation or runtime equivalence of cleaned source

native_audit.scope: Actual card, ring and font paths; item rendering uses a 16x16 pearl-texture stand-in with a depth-writing quad.

validation.visual_result: Pearl and ring centered; 16.0 visible in Bright, Dark, Colored and No Ring themes. Actual card path shown above the shared live HUD renderer.
validation.scope: Offscreen OpenGL with the real card, ring and font paths. Item rendering uses the bundled 16x16 pearl texture in a stand-in that writes depth; full Minecraft item model rendering and gameplay have not been verified in-game.
